steps.title: Set Up RT-PCR Cycling Conditions
steps.instruction: Configure the thermal cycler using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088) with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Cycling (40X): 95°C for 3 sec, followed by 60°C for 30 sec

steps.title: Analyze Real-Time Fluorogenic PCR Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the resulting amplification curves to determine if the result is a satisfactory positive based on specific criteria.

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Compare fluorescence intensity (y-axis) against a positive control.
Confirm the fluorescent curve has clearly exceeded a defined threshold (CT) value early in the log-linear phase.
Classify samples as negative if the CT value is 40 cycles or greater.
Ensure Non-Template Controls (NTCs) do not produce a curve.
